args.summary: Hotfix v2.3.2 shipped to all production regions for checkout-api. Prior version v2.3.1 was unhealthy in production; v2.3.2 has never been released before, so the deployment was routed to change-manager for approval per organizational policy. This incident records the change.
args.title: Deploy of checkout-api hotfix v2.3.2 to all production regions

trace.final:
All done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Checked release history** — v2.3.2 had never been deployed before (previous versions: v2.2.9 and v2.3.0 healthy, v2.3.1 unhealthy), so the deploy required change-manager approval per policy.
2. **Deployed checkout-api v2.3.2** to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). It was routed to the change-manager, who approved it, and the rollout completed successfully.
3. **Opened SEV3 incident INC-0001** recording the change, noting the never-before-deployed hotfix and the approval routing.
4. **Verified post-deploy health** — checkout-api is now healthy on v2.3.2 in all regions, with a low error rate (0.2%).

The on-call engineer has been paged as part of the incident. Let me know if you'd like the incident linked to anything else or a rollback plan documented.
